description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'MembershipDao' for managing 'Membership' entities within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class provides methods for CRUD operations and queries related to memberships, such as saving, retrieving by id or name, listing with filters and pagination, counting, and deleting memberships.

classes.name: MembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for 'Membership' entity, providing methods to perform database operations such as saving, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting memberships within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a 'Membership' entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Membership' entity by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingMembershipIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing membership IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Membership' entity by its name; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of memberships based on filtering parameters, potentially paginated.

methods.name: getMembershipListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for memberships according to filtering and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the count of memberships matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships with specified IDs and returns the number of deleted records.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks whether a membership with the given name already exists.
